results.title: Governor Morrisey Announces $2.4 Million Award to Ascend WV to Strengthen Healthcare Workforce
results.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. (WVDN) – Governor Patrick Morrisey announced a $2.4 million award to Ascend WV to recruit and retain healthcare professionals in rural communities across West Virginia, one of several investments being made through the State’s Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP). “We are moving quickly to put these historic resources to work improving healthcare outcomes for [...] The post Governor Morrisey Announces $2.4 Million Award to Ascend WV to Strengthen Healthcare Workforce appeared first on West Virginia Daily News .
